slides.title: What it is
lines: Gamma turns a prompt or an outline into a finished presentation, webpage, or document in seconds.
It handles layout, images, and styling so you don't fight with slide formatting.
The free tier gives you starter credits; paid plans remove the Gamma badge, add unlimited generations, and unlock custom branding.
slides.narration: Gamma turns a prompt or an outline into a finished presentation, webpage, or document in seconds. It handles layout, images, and styling so you don't fight with slide formatting. There's a free tier to start.

slides.title: What's cool for NCW
lines: Educators: turn lesson notes into a clean slide deck or a parent-night presentation in minutes
SMB owners: build a pitch deck, a one-page service menu, or an investor update without a designer
Community leaders: produce a board presentation or a grant summary that looks professional fast
slides.narration: Here's what's cool for our valley. Educators can turn lesson notes into a clean slide deck or a parent-night presentation in minutes; SMB owners can build a pitch deck, a one-page service menu, or an investor update without a designer; Community leaders can produce a board presentation or a grant summary that looks professional fast.

slides.title: The rules — the AiGovOps way
lines: A human on the trigger — you read it before it goes out
Keep the receipts — save your prompt and the answer
Mind the data cost of “free” — no student records, IEPs, or private details in a free tool
slides.narration: Now the rules, the AiGovOps way. Keep a human on the trigger: you read it before it goes out. Keep the receipts: save your prompt and the answer. And mind the data cost of free — never paste student records, an I-E-P, or a customer's private details into a free tool, because free tools learn from what you type.
